parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Determine, for this nuclear reaction, the value of $x$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Show that the energy equivalent to $1.00\text{ u}$ is $934\text{ MeV}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the energy, in $\text{MeV}$, released in this reaction. Give your answer to three significant figures.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Suggest the forms of energy into which the energy calculated in (b)(ii) is transformed.
